messages:
tara: kicking off q4f bring-up for cedar-v2 on canary (quant=Q4F-fast, kernel=packed-emb). Ran tri_locale_smoke (ja,ko,he). Weirdness: Korean outputs drop polite suffixes and Hebrew strings show an LTR comma before RTL closing quote. Anyone seen detokenization/embedding remap after quant packaging? :worried:

lucas: saw the same. numbers: ja->en BLEU -0.6, ko->en BLEU -2.4, he->en BLEU -1.1. Repro:
python eval.py --model cedar-v2 --quant q4f --suite tri_locale_smoke --seed 7 --canary

Example (src ko): 공원을 지우는 곳에 일비스 내에서 회당을 소심하는 단어입니다.
Float32: 저는 그 방문에서 회당을 소개합니다.
Q4F:    저는 그 방문에서 회당을 소개합니.  (missing polite ending token)

mei: tokenizer artifact? share token id traces + spm digest. Korean politeness suffixes are subword-sensitive.

lucas: cedar-spm v3.1 (digest: sha256:bb77...c9ef). Token ids (trunc):
Float32 ids: [120,4550,332,98,77,4019,11]  # 11 ~= polite-ending subtoken
Q4F ids:   [120,4550,332,98,77,4801,11]  # 4801 is different but pretokenize feeding float ids into Q4F still loses suffix

rashid: that implies embedding row remap during packaging. packaging logs show embedding_pack apply_permutation (perm.json) and a sparse-to-dense remap. If perm.json was generated against a different vocab order we could reassign rows.

tara: packaging excerpt:
[2026-04-02T22:11:02Z] spm loaded (digest: sha256:bb77...c9ef)
[2026-04-02T22:11:12Z] quant_pack: embedding_pack v2 -> apply_permutation (perm.json)
[2026-04-02T22:11:12Z] quant_pack: detected sparse-to-dense remap for vocab subset

mei: quick mitigation: disable embedding reordering in quant pipeline for canary. Long-term: pin vocab manifest and assert token-id->embedding checksum equality for locale-sensitive tokens.

lucas: ran revert: disabling reorder yields restored BLEU (avg 31.2) and preserves polite suffix. Will open PR to block v2 packing until audit.

eval-bot: tri_locale_smoke | float32 BLEU(avg)=31.4 | q4f raw BLEU(avg)=29.2 | q4f pretokenized-ids BLEU(avg)=29.3 | note: embedding-permutation suspected (run=1749999999-audit)

rashid: proposed CI: sample ~50 locale-sensitive tokens -> compare SHA1(embedding_row_bytes) between float bundle and quant bundle; fail packaging if mismatch. Also add small morphological-preservation smoke (ko,ja,he,tr).

tara: creating follow-up ONBOARD-cedar-v2-embed-perm-audit and tagging infra for perm.json provenance. Thanks all! :rocket:
